content: The selection criteria for the annotators required that all annotators must be native speakers of the target language. Preference to annotators with university education was given, but not required. Annotators were asked to complete a spreadsheet containing the translated pairs of words, as well as the part-of-speech, and a column to enter the score. The annotators did not have access to the original pairs in English.
